description.text: Program Description Physiology is a major branch of biology, and it is a subject that studies various life phenomena of organisms, especially the functions of various components of organisms and the internal mechanisms to realize their functions. Duration 3 years Tuition 40000 yuan per year

duration.text: The Physiology at Dalian Medical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6250 USD/per year ￥ 45000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 5.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should hold an educational background equal to a Master degree 2.Qulified by assessment 3.Recommended by two university professors
